function scoreItem(it,tokens){
 let total=0;
 const name=it.name.toLowerCase(), org=it.org.toLowerCase(), tags=it.tags.join('|').toLowerCase(), id=it.id.toLowerCase(), sub=it.subName.toLowerCase(), region=it.region.toLowerCase(), desc=it.desc.toLowerCase();
 for(const t of tokens){
  let s=0;
  if(name.startsWith(t))s=14; else if(name.includes(t))s=9;
  if(id===t||id.endsWith('-'+t))s=Math.max(s,12); else if(id.includes(t))s=Math.max(s,8);
  if(tags.includes(t))s=Math.max(s,7);
  if(org.includes(t))s=Math.max(s,5);
  if(sub.includes(t))s=Math.max(s,4);
  if(region.includes(t))s=Math.max(s,3);
  if(!s&&desc.includes(t))s=1;
  if(!s)return 0;
  total+=s;
 }
 return total;
}

function hi(text,tokens){
 if(!tokens.length)return esc(text);
 const lower=text.toLowerCase();
 let ranges=[];
 for(const t of tokens){const i=lower.indexOf(t); if(i>=0)ranges.push([i,i+t.length]);}
 ranges.sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]);
 // merge overlap
 const merged=[];for(const r of ranges){const l=merged[merged.length-1]; if(l&&r[0]<=l[1])l[1]=Math.max(l[1],r[1]); else merged.push([...r]);}
 let out='',pos=0;
 for(const [s,e] of merged){out+=esc(text.slice(pos,s))+'<mark>'+esc(text.slice(s,e))+'</mark>';pos=e;}
 return out+esc(text.slice(pos));
}

/* ================= 确定性随机工具 ================= */
function mulberry32(seed){let a=seed>>>0;return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};}
const rnd=mulberry32(20260902);
const rint=(lo,hi)=>lo+Math.floor(rnd()*(hi-lo+1));
const pick=arr=>arr[Math.floor(rnd()*arr.length)];
function pickN(arr,n){const c=arr.slice();const out=[];while(out.length<n&&c.length){out.push(c.splice(Math.floor(rnd()*c.length),1)[0]);}return out;}

}
